d1.coursecraft: E17. Observation only, nothing scored. The two cases the script shows: `enroll` refuses a Mon 10:30-12:00 section for a student already in Mon 09:00-10:30, and `room audit` reports a clash between two back-to-back bookings in one room. Both are wrong. `pytest -m conflicts` PASSES, which is the point -- test_back_to_back_is_fine calls slots.overlaps, and the program calls slots.ranges_clash.
d1.confplan: Same shape. `register` refuses a Sat 10:30-12:00 session for an attendee already in Sat 09:00-10:30, `room audit` reports a clash between back-to-back bookings, and the suite is green.

d2.coursecraft: E17, "normalize slot comparison for cross-listed sections and room audits", 2026-07-27. Adds slots.ranges_clash (`<` where slots.overlaps has `<=`) and repoints enrollment.enroll and scheduling.room_clashes at it, orphaning E13's fix three episodes earlier. The message mentions neither conflicts nor enrolment.
d2.confplan: E17, "normalize slot comparison for cross-track sessions and room audits", 2026-07-27. Same shape: adds slots.ranges_clash and repoints registration.register and scheduling.room_clashes at it.
d2._locateNote: ACCEPTED ANSWERS, not one correct string. The two arms name work in different vocabularies, so a sha and a feature label are both right. Matched leniently by web/src/analysis/pipeline.ts locateMatches (case and punctuation ignored, shas by 7+ char prefix) and that match is PROVISIONAL -- the experimenter reads the answer and decides. REGENERATE THE SHAS AFTER EVERY BUNDLE BUILD: the git and sgt arms are separate builds with different shas, and the shas below are from the fixtures at ~/repos/sgt-study, not from a shipped bundle. The sgt arm's feature LABEL is written by an LLM at build time and is not stable across rebuilds, so the feature ID is the anchor and the label is listed as a courtesy.
